subject: Tent pole snapped on first night

messages.name: Dana Whitlock
messages.text: My order BW-48211 arrived Friday and one of the main poles snapped while I was setting it up. We are leaving for Yosemite next weekend. Can you send a new pole in time?

messages.name: Priya Raman
messages.text: I see two charges of 64.00 on my card this month for the salmon kibble.

messages.name: Joel
messages.text: One charge is the box that shipped on the 2nd, the other is the box shipping on the 30th. They are four weeks apart.

messages.name: Priya Raman
messages.text: Ok but I asked to skip October in September. Why did the 30th box get charged already?

messages.name: Joel
messages.text: I can see the skip request in your notes, but it was not applied. I have escalated to billing to refund the second charge.

messages.name: Dr. Imani Osei
messages.text: We ordered 20 cases of medium nitrile gloves on LD-20417 two weeks ago and nothing has come. We run out on Monday. What are our options?

messages.name: Martin Hale
messages.text: The carbon strips on FR-7744 arrived at our Crewe depot without the certificate of conformity. We cannot fit them without it.

messages.name: Sana
messages.text: Thanks Martin. I have asked the Derby warehouse to reissue it from the ERP.

messages.name: Martin Hale
messages.text: Any news? The units are due back in service on Thursday.

subject: Exchange pack for a smaller size

messages.name: Leo Marchetti
messages.text: The Kestrel 40L in medium is too long for my back. Can I swap for a small?

messages.name: Aiyana
messages.text: Of course. I have sent a prepaid UPS label. The small ships as soon as the scan shows your return.

messages.name: Leo Marchetti
messages.text: Dropped it off this morning. The label says it was scanned.

messages.name: Rhiannon Price
messages.text: Order FR-7730 for 120 composite brake blocks shows a date of the 20th. We have a fleet inspection on the 17th. Can it come sooner, and what would that cost?

messages.name: Tomasz Nowak
messages.text: We are away until November. Please skip the next salmon kibble box on TW-1189 and make sure I am not charged for it.

messages.name: Gwen Albright
messages.text: We got 9 of the 12 boxes of prophy paste. Are the other 3 coming?

messages.name: Marco
messages.text: The last 3 boxes are on backorder. A credit for them goes on your next invoice.

messages.name: Gwen Albright
messages.text: We would rather have the paste than the credit. Can you ship the 3 when they arrive instead?

subject: Return a pack I never used

messages.name: Hana Kobayashi
messages.text: I would like to return the Kestrel pack from BW-48390. Still has tags. How do I get my money back?

subject: Week 41 digest for the support lead

messages.name: digest worker
messages.text: Tickets opened this week: 41. Top topics: skipped deliveries not applied (9), new food refused (6), billing date questions (5), damaged bag on arrival (4). Median first reply 2h 10m. Two tickets breached the 24 hour target, both about skipped deliveries.

subject: Dog will not eat the turkey recipe

messages.name: Ama Boateng
messages.text: Our beagle sniffs the turkey food and walks away. It is the first bag.

messages.name: Joel
messages.text: Sorry to hear that. Would you like to try the salmon recipe instead?

messages.name: Ama Boateng
messages.text: Yes please, and can I get the turkey bag refunded?

messages.name: Martin Hale
messages.text: FR-7744 strips are sitting in our depot without the certificate of conformity. When will we get it?

messages.name: Gwen Albright
messages.text: Order LD-20452 came with only 9 of 12 boxes of prophy paste. Please tell me what happens with the rest.

messages.name: Rory Chen
messages.text: Do you ship stoves and fuel canisters to Anchorage?

messages.name: Aiyana
messages.text: Stoves yes. Fuel canisters cannot go by air, so they are excluded for Alaska.

messages.name: Rory Chen
messages.text: Ok, then just the stove. Will it still be 3 to 5 days?

messages.name: Lucia Ferreira
messages.text: This is our first box on TW-1203. If our cat does not like the turkey recipe, what can we do?

messages.name: Rhiannon Price
messages.text: Please quote 60 cast iron brake blocks for our heritage fleet.

messages.name: Sana
messages.text: Cast iron blocks are made to order with a 6 week lead time. I will send a quote today.

messages.name: Rhiannon Price
messages.text: Received, thanks. Can the order be split into two deliveries?

messages.name: Dr. Imani Osei
messages.text: Level 3 masks are out of stock again. What else can we use?

messages.name: Marco
messages.text: The approved substitute is the Crosstex level 3 mask at the same price. Shall I switch your standing order?

messages.name: Dr. Imani Osei
messages.text: Yes, switch it for this month only.
